title: Quantum Computing, Rigetti Computing, TeraWulf, and Xanadu Quantum Technologies shares are falling, what you need to know

content:
What happened?

A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after a hot inflation print pushed Treasury yields above 5% and leadership turmoil at Nvidia stoked concerns across its artificial intelligence partner ecosystem. 

The dual macro and industry pressures mounted after the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the October wholesale producer prices surged 6.5% annually. The data lifted the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield above 5.14%, according to Reuters, fueling expectations of tighter Federal Reserve monetary policy and increasing capital costs across corporate IT budgets. Simultaneously, Nvidia extended a decline from the previous session following the sudden resignation of Chief Executive Jensen Huang, as detailed by Bloomberg. 

The leadership disruption roiled the chipmaker's ecosystem of server integrators, cloud hosting providers, and technical consultancies, raising worries that hardware delivery timetables and enterprise AI integration contracts will stall. When hardware delivery schedules become uncertain and financing costs jump, enterprise clients defer signing deployment contracts, compressing the near-term revenue visibility of the services firms contracted to roll out AI infrastructure.

The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks.

Among others, the following stocks were impacted:

  • Hardware & infrastructure company Quantum Computing fell 5.8%.
  • Hardware & infrastructure company Rigetti Computing fell 7.4%.
  • Hardware & infrastructure company TeraWulf fell 3.9%.
  • Hardware & infrastructure company Xanadu Quantum Technologies fell 11.2%.
